fixtures.content: {"cases": [{"name": "every key fails", "cmd": "printf '%s' '{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"permissionDecision\":\"allow\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"r\",\"updatedInput\":{\"command\":\"c\",\"prompt\":\"p\"},\"additionalContext\":\"x\"}}'; echo e >&2; exit 3", "expect": {"decision": "deny", "reason": "zz", "command": "zz", "prompt": "zz", "context": "zz", "stdout": "zz", "stderr": "zz", "command_absent": "c", "prompt_absent": "p", "no_context": true, "exit": 0}}, {"name": "not_deny fails on a deny", "cmd": "printf '%s' '{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\"}}'", "expect": {"decision": "not_deny"}}, {"name": "plain text reads as no decision", "cmd": "echo hello", "expect": {"decision": "none", "stdout": "hello", "exit": 0}}]}

cases.name: a repo's own case file runs from that repo's root, not the kit's
cases.cmd:
R=$(mktemp -d /tmp/claude-evalrepo-XXXXXX)/er-{{SID}}
rm -rf $R
mkdir -p $R/.claude/evals/cases
printf '{"cases":[{"name":"cwd","cmd":"pwd","expect":{"stdout":"er-{{SID}}"}}]}' > $R/.claude/evals/cases/c.json
bash {{KIT}}/evals/run.sh $R/.claude/evals/cases/c.json | grep passed
rm -rf $(dirname $R)

cases.name: a hook that does not exist fails its case instead of reading as no decision
a case requiring an absent command is skipped and counted apart, the run stays green
CCTOOLKIT_EVALS_STRICT=1 fails the run on a skipped case
a Stop-style answer is read: top-level decision and reason
every expect key reports its own failure, in a fixed order; plain text is no decision

expect.stdout:
FAIL  every key fails — decision=allow(want:deny) reason!~[zz] command!~[zz] prompt!~[zz] context!~[zz] stdout!~[zz] stderr!~[zz] command~[c] prompt~[p] context-present exit=3(want:0)
  FAIL  not_deny fails on a deny — decision=deny
  PASS  plain text reads as no decision

cases.name: -j 2: the files run side by side, printed in their order (a slower first file first), their counts summed

expect.stdout:
par-a
  PASS  a1
par-b
  FAIL  b1
  SKIP  b2
1 passed, 1 failed, 1 skipped

cases.name: --changed: prose reaches no case file; a lib module changed runs the case files of the hooks sourcing it, none other
cases.cmd: R={{FIX}}/chg-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; mkdir -p $R/evals/cases $R/hooks $R/lib && cp {{KIT}}/evals/run.sh $R/evals/ && printf '%s\n' '. "$D/../lib/m.sh"' > $R/hooks/h.sh && echo x > $R/lib/m.sh && echo y > $R/hooks/other.sh && printf '%s' '{"cases":[{"name":"a","hook":"hooks/h.sh"}]}' > $R/evals/cases/a.json && printf '%s' '{"cases":[{"name":"b","hook":"hooks/other.sh"}]}' > $R/evals/cases/b.json && cd $R && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm init && echo doc > README.md && bash evals/run.sh --changed --list && echo '#' >> lib/m.sh && bash evals/run.sh --changed --list; rm -rf $R

expect.stdout:
--changed: no case file reached by the changes
--changed: 1 of 2 case files
  a.json
